insight.headline: Invalid Metafield Queries
insight.what_changed: The GraphQL Admin API now returns an error when a query filters by a metafield that isn't set up for filtering. This change starts in API version 2026-10. Previously, such queries would silently return incorrect results.
insight.developer_impact: Developers should update their GraphQL queries to ensure they only filter by metafields that are properly set up. This change helps prevent incorrect results and makes it easier to debug queries. Developers can test their queries in the GraphQL Admin API to identify any issues before the change takes effect. They should review their code for any queries that might be affected by this change and update them accordingly.
insight.merchant_impact: Merchants will benefit from more accurate results in their Shopify apps, reducing potential errors caused by incorrect metafield queries.
insight.why_it_matters: This change improves the reliability and accuracy of the GraphQL Admin API, making it easier for developers to build robust and trustworthy Shopify apps.
insight.code_example: query { products(first: 10, query: "metafield_key = 'value'") { edges { node { title } } } }

updates.title: Invalid metafield queries now return errors in the GraphQL Admin API
updates.summary: The GraphQL Admin API now returns an error when a query filters by a metafield that isn't set up for filtering, instead of silently returning incorrect results, starting in API version 2026-10.

updates.title: Metafield triggers and additional topics are now available for Events
updates.summary: Apps can now subscribe to events for various topics, including Order, Collection, InventoryItem, and metafield changes on Product, Order, Customer, Collection, and Location.

updates.title: Liquid templates can now compose pages with blocks and partials
updates.summary: Liquid templates can now compose pages with blocks and partials, making it simpler to build theme pages.

updates.title: Full-stack capabilities to power app analytics
updates.summary: Full-stack capabilities are now available to power app analytics, making it easier for app developers to build merchant-facing analytics.

updates.title: Physical inventory feature preview
updates.summary: The physical inventory feature preview is now available, giving early access to a new set of inventory APIs in the unstable version of the GraphQL Admin API.
The CLI version 4.5.2 fixes a warning when running theme commands in valid theme directories and bumps Shopify/theme-tools packages.

updates.title: Card deposit endpoint now requires mTLS certificate
updates.summary: The card deposit endpoint now requires a Shopify-issued mTLS client certificate, affecting apps that store cardholder data.

updates.title: @shopify/cli-hydrogen@13.0.2
updates.summary: Hydrogen version 13.0.2 adds non-interactive shop and storefront creation flags and allows bypassing confirmation prompts in hydrogen upgrade.

updates.title: Updated App Store requirements: 4.1.2 Use a unique name for your app
updates.summary: The App Store requirements have been updated to include the use of a unique name for apps to reduce merchant confusion.

updates.title: Storefront API `@inContext` supports `channelId`
updates.summary: The Storefront API @inContext directive now supports the channelId argument, allowing for specific sales channel context to be applied to an entire query.

updates.title: `productId`, `title`,`variantSku`, and `variantTitle` fields added to `ExchangeLineItem`
updates.summary: The ExchangeLineItem type now includes productId, title, variantSku, and variantTitle fields.

updates.title: POS UI Extensions 2026-07 adds discount allocations to bundle components
updates.summary: POS UI Extensions API version 2026-07 adds discount allocations to bundle components, allowing apps to access component-level discount allocations.

recap.headline: Enhanced GraphQL Admin API, Expanded Webhooks, and Improved Liquid Templates

themes.title: GraphQL Admin API Updates
themes.detail: The GraphQL Admin API now returns errors for invalid metafield queries in API version 2026-10, ensuring more accurate results. This change affects queries that filter by metafields not set up for filtering.

themes.title: Webhooks and Events Expansion
themes.detail: New metafield triggers and topics are available for Events, allowing apps to subscribe to events for various resources like Order, Collection, and Location, as well as metafield changes on key objects.

themes.title: Liquid Templates and App Development
themes.detail: Liquid templates can now compose pages with blocks and partials, simplifying theme page building. Additionally, full-stack capabilities are introduced to power app analytics, reducing the need for external libraries and data warehouses.

actions.text: Update GraphQL Admin API queries to handle new error responses
Explore new webhooks and events for app integration
Migrate to new Liquid template features for theme development
